S.FORM: s-ama-n-kalaku ni-mai lu ilaud
S.PHON: ʂamankalako nimai lo ilaoɖ
S.FORM: samankalako nimai lo ilaod
S.PHON: ʂamankalak[o|u] nimai l[o|u] ila[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: When I was getting ready to come to this country,

S.FORM: ni-myura-sira a-kanu i-ra-ralay ni-mai-sira lu vaǥay-ku
S.PHON: nimjoɻaʂiɻa akano iɻaɻalaj nimaiʂiɻa lo faɰajko
S.FORM: nimiorasira akano iraralay nimaisira lo vahayko
S.PHON: nimi[o|u]ɻaɕiɻa akan[o|u] iɻaɻalaj nimaiɕiɻa l[o|u] faɰajk[o|u]
S.TRANSL: accompanied by the believers, they first went to my house.

S.FORM: at-atlu sira am si-siang-am ni-m-angay
S.PHON: atatlo ʂiɻa am ʂiʂiaŋam nimaŋaj
S.FORM: atatlo sira am sisiangam nimangay
S.PHON: atatl[o|u] ɕiɻa am ɕiɕiaŋam nimaŋaj
S.TRANSL: There were three of them; Siang had gone

S.FORM: ni-mang-an-anau lu kařwan nu ili y-ařwa
S.PHON: nimaŋananao lo ka*wan no ili ja*wa
S.FORM: nimangananao lo kadoan no ili yadoa
S.PHON: nimaŋanana[o|u] l[o|u] kaɖ[o|u]an n[o|u] ili jaɖ[o|u]a
S.TRANSL: to teach in two other villages.

S.FORM: ni-mivis lu vaǥay-ku ma-tika-rana-m
S.PHON: nimifiʂ lo faɰajko matikaɻanam
S.FORM: nimivis lo vahayko matikaranam
S.PHON: nimifiʂ l[o|u] faɰajk[o|u] matikaɻanam
S.TRANSL: After the house had been all swept (and we had made our trip here),

S.FORM: ipanda-ku s-ama-n-kalaku su anem-a-puu a niripi u asa-ka-tau-em
S.PHON: ipanɖako ʂamankalako ʂo anəmapoo a niɻipi o aʂakataoəm
S.FORM: ipandako samankalako so anemapoo a niripi o asakataoem
S.PHON: ipanɖak[o|u] ʂamankalak[o|u] ʂ[o|u] anəmap[o|u][o|u] a niɻipi [o|u] aʂakata[o|u]əm
S.TRANSL: I, Saman Kalaku, was the only one that received six hundred dollars.

S.FORM: y-aku-n-ipanda su y-adwangarnen a niripi-am
S.PHON: jakonipanɖa ʂo jaɖwaŋaɻnən a niɻipiam
S.FORM: yakonipanda so yadoangarnen a niripiam
S.PHON: jak[o|u]nipanɖa ʂ[o|u] jaɖ[o|u]aŋaɻnən a niɻipiam
S.TRANSL: "I'll receive twenty dollars of the money," I said,

S.FORM: aep-en-mu-rana kwan-ku u niripi-am
S.PHON: aəpənmoɻana kwanko o niɻipiam
S.FORM: aepenmorana koanko o niripiam
S.PHON: aəpənm[o|u]ɻana k[o|u]ank[o|u] [o|u] niɻipiam

S.FORM: maniring s-ama-n-kalaku dungyan lu chya kwan-a-m
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ʂamankalako ɖoŋjan lo ʨja kwanam
S.FORM: maniring samankalako dongian lo cia koanam
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ʂamankalak[o|u] ɖ[o|u]ŋian l[o|u] ʨia k[o|u]anam

S.FORM: nun kwan-ku yana-k-angay-rana u niripi-am ka-pitu-araw kwan-ku
S.PHON: non kwanko janakaŋajɻana o niɻipiam kapitoaɻaw kwanko
S.FORM: non koanko yanakangayrana o niripiam kapitoaraw koanko
S.PHON: n[o|u]n k[o|u]ank[o|u] janakaŋajɻana [o|u] niɻipiam kapit[o|u]aɻaw k[o|u]ank[o|u]
S.TRANSL: I'll go now. That was the money for seven days."

S.FORM: ning kwan-a ayui kwan-a
S.PHON: niŋ kwana ajoi kwana
S.FORM: ning koana ayoi koana
S.PHON: niŋ k[o|u]ana aj[o|u]i k[o|u]ana

S.FORM: a-yana-ni-mang-aep ni-padinga-nina? su ipiveravera su ngusu
S.PHON: ajananimaŋaəp nipaɖiŋaninaʔ ʂo ipifəɻafəɻa ʂo ŋoʂo
S.FORM: ayananimangaep nipadinganina so ipiveravera so ngoso
S.PHON: ajananimaŋaəp nipaɖiŋanina ʂ[o|u] ipifəɻafəɻa ʂ[o|u] ŋ[o|u]ʂ[o|u]

S.FORM: a-kanu siken a-kanu vaynget a-kanu alavat
S.PHON: akano ʂikən akano fajŋət akano alafat
S.FORM: akano siken akano vaynget akano alavat
S.PHON: akan[o|u] ɕikən akan[o|u] fajŋət akan[o|u] alafat
S.TRANSL: some soap, a towel, and a bag.

S.FORM: amuri u ha-na-ni-aep nu y-asa-puu
S.PHON: amoɻi o *ananiaəp no jaʂapoo
S.FORM: amori o hananiaep no yasapoo
S.PHON: am[o|u]ɻi [o|u] ɰananiaəp n[o|u] jaʂap[o|u][o|u]
S.TRANSL: So he spent one hundred dollars.
